films.title: Simon Killer
films.overview: A recent college graduate flees to Paris after a break-up, where his involvement with a prostitute begins to reveal a potentially dark recent past.

films.title: Afterschool
films.overview: A prep-school student accidentally films the drug-related deaths of two classmates, then is asked to put together a memorial video.

films.title: Christine
films.overview: In 1974, television reporter Christine Chubbuck struggles with depression and professional frustrations as she tries to advance her career.

films.title: The Devil All the Time
films.overview: In Knockemstiff, Ohio and its neighboring backwoods, sinister characters converge around young Arvin Russell as he fights the evil forces that threaten him and his family.
